name: dashboard-01
title: Dashboard 01 - An Overview Screen Composed Of Slots
description: An overview screen whose composition is the caller's: a header slot for their own PageHeader01, a row of figures drawn on the Metric and Sparkline components, a six-track grid of titled panels each with its own width, and an optional narrow rail at the right. The Block holds no opinion about what a dashboard is for, because a pipeline wants the run queue wide and a watchlist beside it while an estate wants the reverse. Every string and every figure is a prop.
